svg.title: Native grid: x–y, x–z, isometric
svg.desc: Actual active cell boundaries in fixed central sections. Left: x-y at z=0. Middle: x-z at y=0. Right: isometric projection of three perpendicular central sections. Covered coarse interiors are omitted. The static mesh does not change with time.
svg.text: Actual native cell edges · covered coarse interiors excluded · same physical scale · model length units · static grid
